recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散點圖（CD7 對 CD2），非形態影像；大部分藍色族群為 CD2 陽性並伴隨強 CD7 表現，但有一部分延伸到 CD2 較弱，可用來確認這群 T 細胞保留全 T 細胞抗原。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot, CD7-APC700 (x-axis) versus CD2-PC7 (y-axis), gate labeled [AZ]
Dominant blue population with bright CD7 (about 10^1.5 to 10^2) and CD2 expression spanning from dim (about 10^0) to moderate (about 10^1.5)
Overlapping green events within the CD2+CD7+ cluster
Magenta and red events with CD2 expression and dimmer to negative CD7, extending leftward
Small green/magenta CD2-negative, CD7-negative population near the origin
describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot displays CD7 versus CD2 expression within the gated population. The dominant population (blue) expresses bright CD7 with CD2 expression that is mostly moderate but trails into a dimmer subset, while a separate CD2-positive population with dim to negative CD7 (magenta/red) is also present. A small double-negative population sits near the origin. The expression of pan-T antigens CD2 and bright CD7 on the dominant population supports a mature T-cell neoplasm such as T-prolymphocytic leukemia; partial dimming of CD2 is best interpreted together with the other markers in the panel.
